claims.text: Monthly case volumes ranged from a low of 21 cases to a high of 109 cases, with an average of 78.8 cases per month.
The month with the highest reporting volume recorded 109 cases.
Several months exhibited notable month‑over‑month changes, including an increase of 257.1% after the lowest‑volume month and a decrease of 41.3% in a subsequent month.
The highest‑volume observed window contained 61 cases and, like other high‑volume windows (60, 59, and 57 cases), requires human review and contextual assessment.
